<content[
  // Current project creation flow (lines 125-150):
  const handleNewProject = async () => {
    const handle = await window.showDirectoryPicker({ mode: 'readwrite' });
    const newProjectId = generateProjectId();
    const project: ProjectMetadata = {
      id: newProjectId,
      name: handle.name,
      folderPath: handle.name,
      fsaHandle: handle,
      lastOpened: new Date(),
      autoSync: true,
      // MISSING: workspaceBindings, fileSnapshotEnabled
    };
    await saveProject(project);
    await navigate({ to: '/workspace/$projectId', params: { projectId: newProjectId } });
  };

  // MISSING: Workspace selection dialog before navigation
  // User should choose which workspaces to bind this project to
]>

finding.pattern:
Dexie.js database migration requires: 1. Increment database version: db.version(2) 2. Use .upgrade() callback to migrate existing data 3. Access table via tx.table('tableName') 4. Use .toCollection().modify() for bulk updates 5. Always handle migration errors gracefully
Reference: https://dexie.org/docs/Version/Version.stores()

Database versioning best practices: - Always add new versions incrementally (1, 2, 3...) - Keep schema definitions consistent across versions - Use upgrade transactions for data migration - Test with empty and existing databases - Provide fallback for failed migrations
Current codebase has no workspace binding implementation. Projects always navigate to IDE workspace (/workspace/$projectId). No workspace selection dialog exists in HubHomePage.

pattern.name: Dexie.js Versioned Migrations
pattern.description: All database schema changes must use versioned migrations: 1. Increment version number 2. Define upgrade callback 3. Migrate existing data with defaults 4. Test backward compatibility

pattern.name: Interface Extension
pattern.description: Extend interfaces with optional fields for backward compatibility: - Use optional fields (?:) for new properties - Provide default values in migration - Update all consumers to handle optional fields

pattern.name: TDD Discipline
pattern.description: Strict RED-GREEN-REFACTOR cycle: 1. RED: Write failing tests first 2. GREEN: Implement minimal code to pass 3. REFACTOR: Clean up while tests pass 4. Never skip the refactor phase

note.title: Critical: Database Migration Safety
note.content: - Always test migration with existing IndexedDB data - Never clear user's database without consent - Provide fallback if migration fails - Log migration success/failure for debugging

note.title: TypeScript Compilation Must Pass
note.content: - After implementing new fields, run: pnpm exec tsc --noEmit - Zero TypeScript errors allowed - All consumers of ProjectMetadata must handle new fields

note.title: Default Workspace Binding Strategy
note.content: For existing projects: Default to IDE only (ide: true, others: false) For new projects: Show workspace selection dialog in future stories This story only adds the fields, not the UI (Story WB-4)

note.title: File Snapshot Feature Not Yet Implemented
note.content: - fileSnapshotEnabled field added now (Story WB-1) - Actual snapshot implementation in Story WB-2 - Default to false for all projects

note.title: Test Coverage Requirements
note.content: - Unit tests for ProjectMetadata interface extension - Migration tests with empty database - Migration tests with existing projects - TypeScript type validation tests
